summary: Listaway is a self-hosted task management application designed for creating and sharing item lists publicly. It includes administrative tools, authentication, priorities, item notes, and randomized read-only URLs for public sharing as an alternative to proprietary registries.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams wanting to host their own public-facing wishlist or item collection without relying on commercial platforms.
watchOut: With a low adoption footprint and slowing development activity, you may encounter unpatched bugs or need to maintain the software yourself.
deployNotes: As it runs via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
